description: Schedules reminders 30, 7 and 1 days before chosen Act 60 deadlines, each citing its rule, on the verified contact of this session only: it never subscribes another address. A guest is asked for a verified contact first. It stores the reminders, the channel and language preference and a subscription id, nothing else.

channel.description: Where reminders go: email, sms, telegram or whatsapp.

contact.description: The verified contact of this session on that channel (email address, phone number, Telegram id or WhatsApp number); it must match.

deadline_ids.description: Deadline ids from next_deadlines (dated deadlines only).

locale.description: Language of the reminders; default the language of the conversation.

name: remind_me

due.description: The deadline date the reminders lead up to (YYYY-MM-DD).

send_at.description: When each reminder goes out (ISO time, UTC).

subscription_id.description: Reminder subscription id; keep it with the conversation.

title: Remind me of Act 60 deadlines
